proposed_statement_changes.reason: The frozen uniform-in-\(a\) membership claim is incompatible with the closed chart interval and gain window.  Letting \(\lambda\downarrow0\), the rectangle inclusion forces \(\underline g\ge a_-^2/2\) and \(\overline g\le a_+^2/2\), whereas membership of the endpoint chart laws in the same separated model forces the reverse inequalities.  Equality at the upper endpoint still fails because direct conditional-Gaussian differentiation gives \(g(a,t)=a^2/2+\{2-a^2(2-3a^2)^2\}t^2+O(t^3)\), whose quadratic coefficient is positive for \(a<1/2\).  Restricting the testing mirror to the fixed interior midpoint removes only this false endpoint quantifier and supplies exactly the legal product witness consumed by the converse.
